title: CEO/MD Desk
tagline: A statement piece for the corner office — engineered for long days at the helm, finished to reflect the weight of every decision made at it.
overview: The CEO/MD desk is the centrepiece of every leadership floor we design. It carries the brand voice of the company in its proportions, materials, and craftsmanship — the first thing an investor notices in the boardroom video call, the first thing the founders see when they walk in on Monday morning. We build each desk around the person who'll use it: standing or seated, traditional or contemporary, mahogany-and-leather or veneer-and-glass. Every detail — from cable channels that disappear into the legs to a power-and-data module that's flush with the work surface — is engineered to disappear into the work, so what's left on the desk is the work itself.
features: Hand-finished top in chosen veneer, leather inlay, or stone
Cable management routed through the legs and modesty board
Integrated power-and-data module flush with the work surface
Optional privacy screen in matching veneer or frosted glass
Soft-close pedestal drawers on Blum or Hettich runners
Sit-stand height variant with whisper-quiet electric lift
materials: Veneer — Walnut, Oak, Teak, Mahogany, Ebony
Top inlay — Full-grain leather, Calacatta marble, Sintered stone
leadTime: 8–12 weeks from design approval; 4-week rush option available on request.
customization: Custom dimensions and proportions to fit any floor plate
Integrated AV and conferencing modules for boardroom video calls
